title: Pick a stack for a campus event app
persona: Veer, final-year B.Tech, leading a 4-person capstone
scenario: Your capstone is an event-management app for the campus, register, ticket, check-in, photo gallery. 4 of you, 14 weeks, no budget, no DevOps experience. Two teammates know React + Node, one knows Flutter, one knows Django. Everyone wants to use what they know. You need a recommended stack with the actual tradeoff, who's grumpy and why, deployment cost ≤ ₹0/month, AND the real ‘why this over X’ for each choice.
badPrompt: recommend a tech stack for a campus event management app
badOutput: I recommend MERN stack: MongoDB, Express, React, Node.js. It's popular, has a strong ecosystem, and is good for full-stack development. Use Vercel or Railway for free hosting. This stack will work well for an event management app.

hints.title: Force tradeoffs over recommendations
hints.body: ‘For each choice, name what we lose AND who on the team is grumpy.’ Stack picks fail at team-buy-in, not tech.

hints.title: Lock the cost constraint
hints.body: ‘Free tier only. ₹0/month deployment.’ Otherwise AI recommends AWS without thinking about your wallet.

checks.tip: Frame the artifact, a stack recommendation.
Anchor the product, event-management app with specific features.
Anchor the team size and timeline, 4 people, 14 weeks.
Surface the team's existing skills, that's the real constraint.
Lock the cost, ₹0/month deployment, free tier only.
Acknowledge no DevOps experience, that rules out a lot.
Force tradeoffs, what we lose with each choice.
Surface who's grumpy on the team and why. Buy-in matters.
Demand a structured output, choice + why + lose + grumpy.
Force ‘why this over X’ for each choice.

tipIfLow: Stack recommendations fail because AI doesn't know your team. The unlock is anchoring the team's existing skills, the cost constraint (₹0), AND forcing tradeoffs + grumpy-teammate predictions. Tech picks succeed or fail on buy-in, not tech.
goldPrompt: You are a tech-lead picking stacks for unhappy teammates. I'm Veer, leading a 4-person 14-week capstone — campus event-management app (register/ticket/check-in/gallery). Team skills: 2 React+Node, 1 Flutter, 1 Django. Constraint: ₹0/month deployment. Output: ONE recommended stack, then for each choice (frontend, backend, db, hosting): (a) what we lose vs the alternative, (b) which teammate gets grumpy and why, (c) the 'why this over [most plausible alternative]' in one sentence. End with the smallest 2-week mitigation if the grumpy teammate flags risk in week 2. Refuse to pick AWS.
